title: Uniqueness of the Gaussian generator
statement: Let $n\ge0$ and let $f,g,h:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$. If both $g$ and $h$ are Gaussian generators of $f$, then $g=h$ almost everywhere with respect to the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$.
